about: HY-Motion 1.0 clips (ADR 0010). Each clip has a brief, which `npm run motion -- <clip>` turns into scored candidates, and the chosen candidate, which the bake retargets onto the hero (mocap.py). The HY-Motion license limits use, distribution, and display of its outputs to its Territory (worldwide except the EU, the UK, and South Korea); the family publishes on GitHub Pages and accepts that risk (ADR 0010).

stagger.used_by: hero.py: the Stagger clip (a wrong answer)
prompts: A cartoon fighter gets bumped, stumbles two steps backward with arms windmilling for balance, then regains a fighting stance.
A cartoon fighter is pushed on the chest, leans far back with both arms windmilling for balance, hops back one step, then stands up straight in a fighting stance.
A fighter is knocked off balance backward, arms circling wildly, stays upright, then settles back into a guard.
A young hero wins: hops up and punches one fist high into the sky, then lands in a proud fighting stance.
A cheerful fighter celebrates victory, jumps with both fists raised above the head, then stands tall and proud.
A martial artist raises a clenched fist triumphantly to the sky after a win, then settles into a confident ready stance.
victory.note: No profile weight: Victory plays on Results, where the camera frames the hero from the side, so turning toward the camera celebrates toward the player.

charge.used_by: hero.py: the Charge clip (a new Form, after the strike that earned it)
prompts: A fighter plants both feet wide, pulls both clenched fists down to the hips, tenses the whole body, leans the head back as if shouting, holds, then relaxes into a fighting stance.
A martial artist powers up: sinks into a wide low stance, fists clenched at the sides, arms and shoulders shaking with effort, chest pushed out, then settles into a guard.
A cartoon fighter gathers energy, crouches slightly with fists pulled to the waist, trembles with power, throws the chest forward and the head back, then returns to a ready stance.

transform.used_by: hero.py: the Transform clip (the Landmark scene on Results)
prompts: A fighter crouches low with fists clenched at the sides and trembles with power, then bursts upright, throws both arms wide and high, head back, and holds the pose.
A martial artist gathers power in a deep crouch, then rises explosively onto the toes with both fists thrust high above the head and holds the pose proudly.
A cartoon hero hunches over, shaking with energy, then straightens with a mighty shout, arms spread wide and raised, chest out, and holds the pose.
transform.note: No profile weight: the Landmark scene plays on Results, where the camera frames the hero from the side (as Victory).

idle.used_by: hero.py: the Idle clip (between cues; it loops)
prompts: A fighter stands in a relaxed guard with fists up, breathes slowly, and shifts weight gently from foot to foot.
A martial artist waits in a ready stance, fists raised, bouncing lightly on the balls of the feet and breathing calmly.
A cartoon fighter holds a loose fighting stance with both fists up, the shoulders rising and falling with each breath.
